{{Quote|I'm inviting the philosopher Bieque Lozan-Lippid. He's quite well regarded in Narmle, except by Ingon Lakbo, with whom he once engaged in a fistfight on the topic of the nature of evil. Charming man, though, when not out of temper.|Sindra Lintikoor to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Bieque Lozan-Lippod''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Historian/Legends|scholar]] and [[Philosopher/Legends|philosopher]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He resided in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Narmle (city)|Narmle]], on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]], and was considered a great mind. When the [[Ingon Lakbo]], the rival of Lozan-Lippid declined an invitation from [[Sindra Lintikoor]], she tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with delivering an invitation to Lozan-Lippid in his stead.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Bieque Lozan-Lippid]]
Bieque Lozan-Lippid was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
